projects.title: Film Production Showcase
projects.description: A 100% AI-crafted 4K short film for Domino English Learning Centre, where two characters chat about their daily routines in a sunlit seaside cafe. A cinematic drone-style opening, natural window light and classic shot-reverse-shot dialogue make it feel like a real film production.

projects.title: AI Influencer Product Showcase
projects.description: A 100% AI-crafted influencer showcase for ZIST Naturals serum, styled like a real Reels creator video. Selfie-style close-ups, a quick unboxing and soft sunlit shots make it feel like it was filmed on a phone at home.

projects.title: Campaign Product Shoot
projects.description: A 100% AI-crafted beauty campaign for Kalysta Paris' Peptide Mask, from the unboxing to the final glow. Clean studio shots, detailed close-ups and a soft focus pull make every frame feel like a real professional product shoot.

projects.title: Gen Z Fashion Transition
projects.description: A 100% AI-crafted Gen Z unboxing-to-outfit reveal for Polka Dots. A fast zoom-in match cut on the package logo, synced to the beat drop, flips a casual mirror selfie into a full kurta look in seconds, so real it feels shot on a phone.

projects.title: AI UGC Ad
projects.description: A 100% AI-crafted UGC ad for Dari Mooch's De-Tan grooming range, with a relatable creator walking through a simple 3-step routine. Real-feel bathroom and shower scenes, close-up product shots and punchy cuts make it look like an authentic creator video that sells.

projects.title: AI Avatar Style Editing
projects.description: A 100% AI-crafted avatar video for a Codecure AI hiring campaign, edited to feel like a real corporate shoot. Animated captions, smooth zoom-ins, clean motion graphics and light-leak transitions turn a simple talking avatar into an engaging, scroll-stopping ad.

projects.title: AI Model Campaign
projects.description: A 100% AI-crafted fashion campaign featuring a hyper-realistic model in an embroidered cream kurta. Slow close-ups, low-angle full-body shots and smooth camera moves give it the feel of a real luxury shoot, captured in a warm, moody library set.

projects.title: SKIN CARE AD SHOT
projects.description: A 100% AI-crafted skincare commercial for MOOD CARE Hydra Glow Gel Cream, built to look like a real beauty campaign. Every angle, close-up and camera move feels like it was shot on a professional set, right down to the dewy final glow.
